function: Excluded as no_learning: joint localization and channel estimation by an iterative variational Bayesian inference algorithm with closed-form updates, fixed priors, and no trained model (pp. 1, 9).
notes: no_learning. p. 1: "closed-form solution in each iteration, our proposed iterative" algorithm; p. 9: "Our proposed algorithm is an iterative algorithm developed" to approximate the posterior by mean-field factorization and KL minimization. Algorithm 1 and Table I (p. 10) use fixed priors and settings; the paper has no neural network, dataset or training, and compares only with ML and PSO. 'Learning' in the title means Bayesian posterior inference per received signal. PDF is arXiv:2403.01093v1 (2 Mar 2024), 'Variational Bayesian Learning Based Localization and Channel Reconstruction in RIS-aided Systems'; the DOI is not printed in the text.
